title: Huna Mari bar Mar Zutra Nesi’a
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Iggeret Rav Sherira Gaon, part 3, chapter 3, which reports that he was killed with Mesharshiya on 18 Tevet. Hyman gives the year as תשפא. He may have been a grandson of Rav Huna bar Natan, the Exilarch.

notes.text: The date is preserved as השפא without imposing a calendar or modern-year conversion. The proposed grandson relationship remains tentative.

The saved whole Seder HaChachamim, Oxford 1888 epistle paragraph dates the arrests to תשפ״א and reports Huna bar Mar Zutra and Mesharshiya killed on 18 Tevet. It supplies a year/name comparison alongside source השפא and heading Huna Mari, without converting calendars, deciding the name’s Mari element, proving a letter’s history or mapping Hyman’s part/chapter numbering. Hyman’s possible grandson relationship remains tentative.

The year השפא in the earlier notes comes from the supplied text. Hyman’s printed notice (vol. I, p. 358) has תשפא. The Oxford 1888 edition of the epistle dates the arrests to תשפ״א and reports the killing of Huna bar Mar Zutra Nesi’a and Mesharshiya on 18 Tevet. That edition omits Mari from Huna’s name in this account. The year is given in the source’s notation, and the proposed grandson relationship is Hyman’s suggestion.
